{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-7d5i","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-yotd: TH_4 missing CRED_I, uses ciphertext not plaintext","description":"## Spec deviation: TH_4 composition

**File:** python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py  
**Lines:** 424 (initiator), 678 (responder)

**What the code does:**
```python
th_4_input = cbor2.dumps(self._th_3) + cbor2.dumps(ciphertext_3)
```
Only 2 elements (TH_3, CIPHERTEXT_3), missing CRED_I entirely. Uses ciphertext instead of plaintext.

**What RFC 9528 §5.4.2/§5.5 requires:**
> Compute the transcript hash TH_4 = H(TH_3, PLAINTEXT_3, CRED_I),
> where H() is the EDHOC hash algorithm... The input to the hash
> function is a CBOR Sequence.

Requires 3 elements: TH_3, PLAINTEXT_3, and CRED_I.

This is a correctness/interop bug that would produce a different TH_4 value, which in turn affects PRK_out derivation.

**Severity:** P1 - correctness/spec-compliance.
